title: Speaker Dy mourns death of 2 students in Cauayan City fun run

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – House Speaker and Isabela Rep. Faustino G. Dy III on Sunday extended his sympathies to the family of the two students who died during a fun run at the Cauayan South Central School. The fatalities, aged 7 and 8, were electrocuted during a bubble fun run on Saturday, Oct. 3. “Lubos akong nakikiramay sa mga pamilya ng dalawang mag-aaral na nasawi sa malagim na insidente sa Cauayan South Central School,” Dy said in a statement. “Nang malaman ko ang nangyari, agad akong nagtungo sa paaralan upang personal na alamin ang sitwasyon at makausap ang mga kinauukulan.” he added.
